name: Thurea
author: Thurea
description: Thurea family protection in the Omarchy bar: protection status, the verse of the day, and one-scan setup for Android phones. Installed from this repository with `omarchy plugin add`; Thurea itself comes from your package manager.

barWidget.description: Shows whether this computer is protected, the verse of the day, and a QR code to set up a new Android phone with Thurea. Middle-click: set up a phone.
